info.name: AI in Talk: document sandbox
info.summary: The document sandbox of AI in Talk as an External App, for servers without containers of their own
info.description:
The workshop in which [AI in Talk](https://apps.nextcloud.com/apps/talk_ai) builds office documents with code: Python and Node with the document libraries, LibreOffice and Poppler, and the skills for each format. Each job runs as a user of its own without network (seccomp), with limits for memory, processes, time and space, one at a time.
Install it with AppAPI (a deploy daemon, e.g. HaRP); AI in Talk finds it by itself. Where the server can run the sandbox's own runner with Docker or Podman, that is the stronger isolation (a container per job).
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
